root_cause_and_implementation: FASE 1: test_promote_single_day_repair_candidate_first_execution_marks_metadata_and_keeps_current_publication_non_current (whose narrative -- a successful repair candidate -- is no longer reachable) is renamed test_promote_single_day_repair_candidate_fails_closed_on_incomplete_producer_evidence and rewritten to wrap promoteSingleDay(..., 'repair_candidate') in try/catch, asserting the thrown RuntimeException names INPUT_CAPTURE_BINDING_MANIFEST_INCOMPLETE and specifically provider_mapping and source_observations (not a generic pipeline failure), then querying the derived run row directly (found by trade_date_requested, since the exception prevents $repairRun from ever being assigned) to assert terminal_status=FAILED, final_reason_code=RUN_HASH_FAILED, publishability_state=NOT_READABLE, the STAGE_FAILED event carries the same reason/message, the correction is not recorded REPAIR_EXECUTED, and the pre-existing current pointer (publication_id=1) is untouched. test_promote_single_day_repair_candidate_rerun_increments_execution_count_and_preserves_current_pointer is renamed test_promote_single_day_incremental_fails_closed_identically_to_repair_candidate and rewritten to run the scenario twice -- once with 'repair_candidate', once with 'incremental' -- proving both throw the identical reason and both derived runs persist with promote_mode='repair_candidate' after resolvePromoteContext()'s alias normalization, i.e. the alias identity is proven at the persisted-state level, not merely assumed from reading the source. FASE 2 (design only, nothing implemented): re-traced the exact call chain for every C1 domain against a derived promote run. Confirmed via direct exception-message inspection that only two of twelve C1 domains are ever reported missing for this entry path: C03 (provider_mapping) and C06 (source_observations) -- exactly 'provider_mapping.provider-mapping-revisions/v1,provider_mapping.provider-source-row-link/v1,source_observations.no_producer_ingress_population,source_observations.source-observation-outcomes/v1', nothing else. Traced why each of the other ten domains already works, each with an existing code-level basis: C01 (run/config) is explicitly re-resolved fresh at EodRunRepository::createPromoteRunFromSeedWithinTransaction (EodRunRepository.php:337-340, with an existing comment explaining why: 'claiming the seed's identity would attribute a configuration this run never used'), then immediately captured under the derived run's own run_id via captureRunConfiguration (EodRunRepository.php:369) -- an existing, already-implemented precedent that domains tied to this specific execution's own resolved state are re-derived fresh, not inherited. C02/C04/C05/C08/C09/C10/C11/C12 are captured by COMPUTE_INDICATORS/BUILD_ELIGIBILITY, which the derived run does execute under its own run_id, against continuously-maintained reference state (calendar, sector/event-risk sources, factor decisions, registries) correctly re-derived as of now for every run, mainline or derived alike -- nothing acquisition-specific about them. C07 (RAW/history) already correctly distinguishes the requested date (read from the immutable, per-publication eod_bars_history via EodArtifactRepository::loadBarsForTradeDate/loadBarsWindow scoped to the derived candidate's own publication_id, materialized by ensureBarsHistoryFromCurrentTradeDate when $useHistory is true, EodIndicatorsComputeService.php:56-68) from lookback/dependency dates (read from the shared canonical eod_bars table, by explicit existing design documented in EodArtifactRepository.php:463-464: 'Earlier dates remain current canonical inputs') -- this is not reading current/latest state to fabricate historical identity, since the current canonical bars are exactly what a correction candidate is meant to recompute over; only the requested date's own snapshot is frozen per-publication, and it already is. C03/C06 are broken because their sole capturing producers (EquityProviderSymbolResolver/TemporalIdentityRepository/SourceObservationRepository for C03; EodBarsIngestService::acquireSourceRows/ingestAcquiredRows for C06) only ever run from within INGEST_BARS/ACQUISITION-stage code, which a derived promote run never executes by design -- there is no new acquisition event to capture from. Confirmed the existing, already-established seed-run provenance link: createPromoteRunFromSeedWithinTransaction already records seed_run_id in its RUN_CREATED event's immutable event_payload_json (EodRunRepository.php:348-367) for every promote-from-seed run, historical and future -- nothing needs to be built to establish this link, only read. Confirmed the C1 contract's own text already authorizes referencing over duplicating for exactly this shape: Sec3.1's general principle (component entries carry 'immutable source references sufficient to verify the content') and Sec5's C06 row specifically ('carry contents or verifiable immutable references, not an unexplained digest'). Confirmed ProducerInputCompletionManifest.php already implements this exact reference-and-verify shape for a same-run case today (the provider-mapping-revisions/v1 handling at lines 68-85 locates a referenced 'population' capture by stage_code/slot_hash and rejects it unless (int) $reference['run_id'] === (int) $run->run_id and the payload hash matches exactly) -- the one deliberate change needed is widening that single equality check to accept the run's own id or its recorded seed run's id, not inventing new architecture. Classified the mechanism as IMPLEMENTATION_DERIVABLE for both C03 and C06: the whether (LOCKED authority), the interim fail-closed correctness (C1 Sec5), and the reference-not-duplicate shape (C1 Sec3.1/Sec5 text plus existing code precedent) are all already settled; only a narrow, low-stakes implementation choice remains open (read the seed link from the existing RUN_CREATED event payload vs. add a first-class column -- either satisfies authority equally) and the exact new reference-check code for C06 (C03 can extend an existing check; C06 needs an analogous new one following the same shape, since none exists yet for that domain). No component of this classification required, or invented, a new owner decision. Nothing in FASE 2 was implemented: no change to RunInputCaptureRepository, ProducerInputCompletionManifest, PublicationInputBindingService, or any migration/schema, per explicit user instruction that this turn is audit/design only.
